neighbours.label: a business-function term in corporate or administrative prose: the word that opens a work function or task (investor [relations], select business [categories], setting [targets], establish [objectives])
fire: Please direct all inquiries to Mark Chen, director of investor relations, at the main office.
Shareholders may reach our investor relations team by phone or email.
Cardholders earn double points on travel and select business purchases each year.
Managers are responsible for setting targets and tracking progress each quarter.
The coordinator will set up meetings with vendors and maintain project schedules.
Our consultants help clients establish and track performance objectives across departments.
The analyst supports the CFO by preparing reports and setting budget priorities.
For press inquiries contact the media office; for investor questions contact the treasury team.
quiet: The investor sold most of her shares after the earnings call.
The company headquarters moved to a larger building downtown last spring.
Our office is closed on public holidays and reopens on Monday morning.
The quarterly report was printed on recycled paper this year.
Many employees enjoy lunch in the courtyard when the weather is nice.
The firm was founded in 1985 by two brothers from Ohio.
The chief executive spoke briefly and thanked the staff for their patience.
Several analysts expected the stock price to rise after the announcement.
